name: Relevance
description: The degree to which the response is related to the context and maintains the flow of the conversation.

name: Coherence
description: The logical consistency of the response and its grammatical correctness.

name: Interestingness
description: The degree to which the response provides new, engaging, or thought-provoking information.

name: Factuality
description: The accuracy of any factual information or claims presented in the response.

name: Politeness
description: The level of courtesy, respect, and appropriateness demonstrated in the response.
